consequence.statement: Access logs gain an additional TLS client subject entry; no failure or required operator action is stated.

original.statement: Traefik access logs now include the TLS client subject.

decision.reason: [ev-9ddb01602beb] lists 'Log TLS client subject' only as an addition under Enhancements in the v3.0.0 changelog. It says nothing about anything failing, being rejected, no longer being honoured or needing migration, so no action-eligible kind is supported. The evidence also doesn't say the feature is on by default or that it changes existing log output in a way that needs review, so 'none' (informational) is the best-supported reading. Confidence is low because the one-line excerpt doesn't say whether the new field appears without opt-in.
